text:
maria: Quick heads-up — EU midnight change window scheduled for 23:30 UTC tonight. This is the v2.3.4 rollout (model pin + infra tweak). Posting a short readiness checklist, please ack or flag blockers.
raj: Ack. I'll pin the model to v2.3.4-rc5 in the deploy manifest and prepare canary traffic plan.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Steps: create canary, run smoke, shift traffic. CLI: `rb deploy start --canary --tag v2.3.4-rc5`
maria: Checklist (TL;DR):
- Pin model version in manifest
- Release notes published
- Canary smoke passed on staging
- Rollback steps tested and documented
- SRE circuit-breaker updated
- Oncall coverage confirmed
noah: Release notes pushed to the docs repo and the release bullet list is in the PR description. Two notable changes: improved KV cache warm-up and embedding quantization changes (should lower cost).
tess: QA update: staging smoke green, unit/regression quick suite green, but I did see an embedding tail latency increase ~12% at 512 batch on p4. Reproduced once, investigating.
kevin: SRE: noted. I'll lower the circuit-breaker threshold to 10rps for the canary path and add automatic fallback to cpu-quantized model on latency spike. Will post config snippet shortly.
kevin: config snippet:
```
circuit_breaker:
  path: /v1/generate
  threshold_rps: 10
fallback_policy:
  on_latency_pct: 95
  fallback_model: v2.3.3-cpu-quant
```
raj: If embedding perf reg persists we should hold before 50% shift. Rollback play: pin back to v2.3.3 and disable cache warming. Commands I will run: `rb deploy pin v2.3.3` then `rb deploy shift --to v2.3.3 --force`.
deploy-bot: rollback plan queued. Manual confirmation required to execute rollback: `rb confirm rollback 2470012345`
olivia: Oncall: I'll be primary during the window (23:15-01:00 UTC). Pager rotations updated. Ping me in #oncall for immediate lift.
maria: Decision: Proceed with canary tonight but HOLD prior to 50% traffic shift until QA + SRE confirm embedding latency steady or fallback validated. Raj, coordinate the hold with deploy-bot.
raj: Roger. I'll add a manual gate at 50% and set a 20-minute hold for monitoring.
deploy-bot: canary started at 23:30 UTC, canary id cb-2470012345. Smoke tests running: 0 failures so far.
tess: Running extended regression (+ perf runner) now — will report at T+10m.
maria: Thanks all. If no new blockers after T+15m we lift the hold and continue. If embedding latency reproduces, we roll back immediately per Raj's command. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll keep metrics dashboard pinned and set an alert to fire on 15% P95 increase vs baseline.
noah: FYI I updated the changelog to call out the embedding behavior note and the rollback instructions so customer-facing teams have a short blurb if asked.
olivia: Acks from me and SRE. Standby channel: #eng-releases-live.
maria: Final: confirm ack in thread once you see the canary smoke green. Then we wait the 15m observation window. Thank you.
